searchText: I'm not sure this is spam per se, it was only posted in a couple of channels as far as I could see. Yeah, with no relation to those channels. That's spam 😄 I'm curious to see replies, cause I didnd't even understand the complain, that's why I didn't want that to be removed 🙂 But it's too persistant. A repeated plea across multiple conversations is spam. A focused plea on one channel? I might be on board with seeing where it goes. But this one is off-topic and repeated. he posted it in like 9 channels, i deleted all but (i thought) one
